theories.title: Digest second-order, unmentioned implications beat the vol prior
theories.state_rule: status NEEDS_CELL, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: per-date Brier improvement of order-2 unmentioned rows <= 0 once >= 10 decision dates are graded
theories.mechanism: The synthesis finds second-order paths no article named; if they carry information, those rows beat their own vol prior more than first-order rows.
theories.precursor: frozen news_digest implication rows with order=2 and mentioned_in_articles=False

theories.title: Customer demand shock read-through to supplier basket
theories.state_rule: status NEEDS_CELL, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If the linked supplier basket's beta-adjusted open-to-close residual at t+1 is not positive relative to matched unlinked suppliers (spread <= 0, t < 1), refuted.
theories.mechanism: A large positive demand surprise at a major customer (guidance raise, order acceleration) implies incremental volume for its disclosed key suppliers, so supplier basket drifts up next session beyond market beta.
theories.precursor: Customer reports guidance raise or order-acceleration language in earnings release before open; supplier linkage disclosed in prior filings or co-mentions.

theories.title: Customer guidance cut drags suppliers next session
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If linked suppliers show no significant next-session abnormal return relative to vol-matched unlinked peers, the hypothesis is refuted.
theories.mechanism: A major customer's guidance cut implies lower future orders, so its suppliers' stocks fall the next session as investors anticipate revenue shortfalls.
theories.precursor: Customer (co-mentioned as customer in prior news) issues guidance cut with >2 sd reaction at close t.

theories.title: Equity issuance by peer predicts dilution fears next session
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If co-mentioned peers show no significant next-session abnormal return relative to vol-matched unlinked peers, the hypothesis is refuted.
theories.mechanism: When a firm announces an equity issuance, investors infer that its close peers may also need capital, so peers' stocks decline the next session on dilution fears.
theories.precursor: Source firm announces equity issuance with >2 sd reaction at close t; peers co-mentioned in prior news about financing or same sector.

theories.title: Guidance cut by bellwether triggers supplier sell-off
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If linked suppliers show no significant negative abnormal return relative to unlinked industry peers over the next 3 sessions, the hypothesis is refuted.
theories.mechanism: When a sector bellwether cuts guidance due to weak demand, its suppliers experience negative read-through as investors anticipate order reductions, but the effect is delayed for smaller suppliers with less analyst coverage.
theories.precursor: A bellwether firm issues a guidance cut citing demand weakness, with a stock price drop >5% on the day, before market close.

theories.title: Guidance cut read-through to supplier-heavy peers
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If the supplier-linked basket's next-session abnormal return is statistically indistinguishable from the vol-matched peer basket, or has the opposite sign, the hypothesis is refuted.
theories.mechanism: When a large customer cuts guidance, suppliers with high revenue concentration to that customer see demand risk repriced over the following sessions, while unrelated sector peers do not.
theories.precursor: A guidance_change event from a source firm whose 10-K discloses customer concentration, filed before the source's next-session move.

theories.title: New contract read-through to component suppliers
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If the supplier basket's next-session abnormal return is indistinguishable from or worse than sector controls, the hypothesis is refuted.
theories.mechanism: A large new contract or partnership announcement by a prime contractor signals incremental demand for its disclosed component suppliers, lifting those suppliers beyond sector beta.
theories.precursor: A new_contract_or_partnership event at a source firm with disclosed suppliers in prior filings or news.

theories.title: Regulatory approval read-through to contract manufacturers
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If the CDMO basket's next-session abnormal return is indistinguishable from or worse than sector controls, the hypothesis is refuted.
theories.mechanism: An FDA approval for a small-cap drug developer signals near-term manufacturing demand for its disclosed CDMO partners, lifting those suppliers more than sector beta.
theories.precursor: A regulatory_approval event at a source firm with disclosed manufacturing partners in prior filings or news.

theories.title: Supplier co-mention read-through after customer guidance cut
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If linked suppliers' next-session residual return is not more negative than vol-matched unlinked peers (t < 1), the read-through is refuted.
theories.mechanism: When a major customer cuts guidance, its named suppliers in earlier co-mention news reprice downward next session as the market digests demand spillover, a second-order effect distinct from the customer's own move.
theories.precursor: Customer's guidance_change event with large negative reaction; supplier names co-mentioned with customer in prior 90-day news.

theories.title: Supplier shock passes through to customer margin expectations
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If linked customers show no significant negative abnormal return relative to matched unlinked firms in the same sector over t+1 to t+5, the hypothesis is refuted.
theories.mechanism: When a key supplier reports an unexpected margin squeeze or cost inflation, its downstream customers face higher input costs that the market may not have priced into their earnings expectations yet, causing customer stocks to drift down over subsequent sessions.
theories.precursor: A supplier's earnings report discloses gross margin decline >200bps QoQ or explicit cost inflation guidance, publicly before market open on t+1.

theories.title: Supplier shock transmits to customer via input concentration
theories.state_rule: status NEEDS_CELL, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If high-concentration customers' open-to-close residual at t+1 is not more negative than low-concentration matched peers (difference <= 0 with t < 1), the mechanism is refuted.
theories.mechanism: A sharp adverse move in a supplier signals input-cost or availability stress; customers with high input concentration from that supplier face margin compression, so their next-session returns drift down beyond market beta.
theories.precursor: Supplier has a large one-day abnormal move (|z|>=2) on an input-relevant event (guidance cut, plant outage, export control) while customer's prior 10-K/transcript discloses high supplier concentration.

theories.title: Airline capacity cuts lift legacy carriers over low-cost
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If legacy carriers do not outperform low-cost carriers in the 1-5 day window, refuted.
theories.mechanism: Announced capacity cuts by a major airline reduce industry supply, benefiting legacy carriers with higher margins more than low-cost carriers. Equity re-rates on pricing power.
theories.precursor: Public announcement of domestic capacity cuts by a major US airline, before next open.

theories.title: Analyst target cut spreads to co-covered peers
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: Co-covered peers' abnormal returns are indistinguishable from vol-matched unlinked peers.
theories.mechanism: When an analyst slashes a target on one name, co-covered peers with shared end-markets get de-rated as the same thesis is reapplied.
theories.precursor: Analyst_target_change event with large negative revision on a source name with high co-mention ratio to peers.

theories.title: Clinical trial failure drags co-mentioned pipeline peers
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: Linked peers show no negative next-session excess return vs unlinked (t < 1.0) or positive sign.
theories.mechanism: A clinical_trial_result failure for one drug class raises read-across probability of failure for peers with similar mechanism, especially small biotech with single asset.
theories.precursor: Source biotech reports clinical_trial_result with negative reaction > 3x vol; peers identified by prior co-mention in trial news.

theories.title: Co-mentioned peers react to clinical trial failure
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: Peer abnormal returns are indistinguishable from vol-matched unlinked controls in the confirm sample.
theories.mechanism: A clinical trial failure at one biotech spills over to co-mentioned peers with similar pipelines as investors reassess platform risk.
theories.precursor: Source biotech's clinical_trial_result event with a sharp negative return and news co-mentions of peers.

theories.title: Correlation-peer spillover after a clinical trial miss
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: Correlation peers' XBI-hedged next-session return is zero or positive after the source miss.
theories.mechanism: A Phase 3 miss at one biotech raises perceived class-wide regulatory or mechanism risk, dragging return-correlation peers the next session before idiosyncratic data is parsed.
theories.precursor: Source biotech moves >= 4 sd on clinical_trial_result with negative sign; peers identified by 60-day return correlation >= 0.5.

theories.title: Correlation-peer spillover after clinical trial failure
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If correlation peers do not underperform vol-matched non-peers the next session, class-risk spillover is refuted.
theories.mechanism: A trial failure signals platform or class risk, so high-return-correlation peers in the same therapeutic class sell off next session.
theories.precursor: Source biotech's clinical_trial_result with large negative reaction and a peer with top decile 60-day return correlation.

theories.title: Correlation-peer spillover after regulatory approval
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If the linked peer basket's residual return is not significantly higher than unlinked vol-matched peers (t < 1), the spillover is refuted.
theories.mechanism: A regulatory approval for one firm signals a favorable regime shift for its correlation peers, causing next-session co-movement beyond sector beta as traders extrapolate the policy read.
theories.precursor: Source firm's regulatory_approval event with large positive reaction; top correlation peers from trailing 60-day returns.

theories.title: Equity issuance dilution hits co-mentioned cash-burning peers
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: Linked peers show no negative next-session excess return vs unlinked (t < 1.0) or positive sign.
theories.mechanism: A dilutive equity_issuance by one cash-burning firm signals sector-wide funding stress, raising dilution probability for co-mentioned peers with similar burn rate.
theories.precursor: Source firm announces equity_issuance_dilution with negative reaction > 2x vol; peers co-mentioned in prior financing news.

theories.title: Equity issuance dilution readthrough to correlated peers
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: Correlation peers' sector-hedged next-session return is zero after the dilution event.
theories.mechanism: A dilutive equity raise signals sector funding stress; return-correlation peers with similar cash-burn profiles sell off next session as investors extrapolate refinancing risk.
theories.precursor: Source name announces equity_issuance_dilution and drops >= 3 sd; peers = 60-day return correlation >= 0.5.

theories.title: Equity issuance dilution signals overvaluation, peers follow
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If linked peers show no significant negative abnormal return relative to unlinked sector peers over the next 2 sessions, the hypothesis is refuted.
theories.mechanism: When a firm announces a secondary equity offering, it may signal that management believes shares are overvalued, leading investors to question valuations of similar firms and sell them off.
theories.precursor: A firm announces a secondary equity offering with a discount to current price, before market open.

theories.title: Event readthrough via peer correlations
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: Peer companies do not show a return increase beyond their own volatility in the next trading session.
theories.mechanism: Peer companies can experience similar market reactions due to shared factors.
theories.precursor: A company in a specific industry experiences a large market reaction to a news event.

theories.title: Regulatory approval lifts correlated pipeline peers
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: No incremental next-session abnormal return for correlation peers versus vol-matched unlinked peers.
theories.mechanism: A regulatory approval for one drug validates the mechanism/endpoint, lifting return-correlation peers with similar pipeline assets.
theories.precursor: Regulatory_approval event on a source name with high return correlation to peers in the same therapeutic space.

theories.title: Airline capacity cut lifts legacy hotel REITs
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: No return differential between non-airport and airport-adjacent hotel REITs in the session after the capacity-cut announcement.
theories.mechanism: When a major airline announces domestic capacity reductions, stranded business travelers substitute toward drive-to and regional hotel stays, benefiting hotel REITs with non-airport exposure.
theories.precursor: Airline publicly announces capacity cut (public at t); hotel REITs with low airport-adjacent revenue share are identifiable.

theories.title: Chip fab capex raise lifts deposition tool suppliers
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: High-exposure suppliers show no return advantage over low-exposure peers in the t+1 to t+5 window.
theories.mechanism: When a leading-edge fab publicly raises capex guidance, deposition and etch tool suppliers with concentrated exposure to that fab receive order-flow read-through before analyst revisions.
theories.precursor: Fab capex guidance raise is public at t; supplier revenue concentration to that fab is disclosed in filings.

theories.title: Earnings miss by a retailer hits suppliers with high customer concentration
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If high-concentration suppliers do not underperform low-concentration peers after the miss, refuted.
theories.mechanism: A major retailer's earnings miss signals weaker consumer demand, pressuring suppliers with high revenue concentration to that retailer. Equity re-rates on lower order expectations.
theories.precursor: Public earnings miss by a major retailer (e.g., WMT, TGT, HD), before next open.

theories.title: Rail volume shock read-through to truckload peers
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: No spread between truckload and rail equities on the day after a rail disruption beyond IYT beta.
theories.mechanism: A rail service disruption shifts freight to truckload carriers, lifting spot rates and trucker equities next session.
theories.precursor: Public rail outage or embargo announcement by a Class-I railroad before the close.

theories.title: Retailer earnings miss drags logistics peers next session
theories.state_rule: status PROPOSED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: No negative excess return for linked logistics vs unlinked logistics (t < 1.0) or positive sign.
theories.mechanism: Large retailer earnings miss implies volume cuts that flow to parcel/trucking/freight names with high revenue concentration to that retailer.
theories.precursor: Retailer reports earnings_report with negative surprise > 1.5x trailing surprise sd; logistics peers identified by co-mention.

theories.title: Federal fiscal-year-end spending: federal contractors in August-September
theories.state_rule: status DECLARED, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: validate (FY2017-FY2024) Aug-Sep minus own-baseline excess return <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE below the effect worth having; AND (dose) the high-federal-share tercile must not be below the low tercile -- an effect that does not scale with federal exposure is not this mechanism
theories.mechanism: Agencies obligate unspent fiscal-year funds before Sept 30 (use it or lose it; fiscal Q4 carries a disproportionate share of contract obligations), producing an order/revenue uptick for federal-exposed contractors that the market may under-anticipate.
theories.precursor: fiscal-Q4 (Jul-Sep) contract obligations by awarding agency vs the agency's trailing 3-FY Q4 share, as SNAPSHOTTED on the decision date (usaspending_awards.pull_agency_months; a month total revises as late reports land, DoD ~90 days), plus the name's federal revenue share from its last 10-K customer segment (Compustat seg_customer ctype GOVDOM) -- both knowable before Aug 1

theories.refutation: forward paper fills: net of realised fill cost and missed fills, 5-session abnormal <= 0

theories.title: Commodity input shock hits downstream specialty chemical margins
theories.state_rule: status NEEDS_CELL, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If the target basket does not underperform its market-beta-adjusted expectation over the next 1-5 days after the shock, the hypothesis is refuted.
theories.mechanism: A sharp rise in a key commodity (e.g., natural gas) increases input costs for specialty chemical firms that cannot immediately pass through costs, leading to margin compression and negative returns for those firms.
theories.precursor: Daily close-to-close change in the commodity futures price exceeds 2 standard deviations of its trailing 60-day volatility.

theories.title: Copper price spike lifts copper miners over diversified miners
theories.state_rule: status NEEDS_CELL, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If pure-play copper miners do not outperform diversified miners after a copper spike, refuted.
theories.mechanism: A sharp rise in copper prices disproportionately benefits pure-play copper miners vs diversified miners with other commodity exposure. Equity re-rates on higher realized prices.
theories.precursor: Copper futures (HG=F) daily change >= 2 trailing sd, before next open.

theories.title: Copper spike lifts electrical equipment over diversified industrials
theories.state_rule: status NEEDS_CELL, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: High-intensity basket shows no underperformance vs low-intensity basket in the t+1 to t+5 window.
theories.mechanism: A copper price spike raises input costs for electrical equipment makers with weak pass-through, pressuring them relative to diversified industrials with hedged or lower copper intensity.
theories.precursor: Copper futures daily change >= 2 trailing sd at close t; copper intensity disclosed in filings.

theories.title: Copper spike lifts miners over industrials
theories.state_rule: status NEEDS_CELL, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: No significant spread between miners and industrials after beta adjustment in the expected direction.
theories.mechanism: A sharp copper price rise boosts margins for copper miners while raising costs for copper-consuming industrials, creating a relative spread.
theories.precursor: Daily copper futures (HG=F) move >= 2 standard deviations at close t.

theories.title: Dollar spike hits EM-exposed US multinationals next week
theories.state_rule: status NEEDS_CELL, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: High-foreign-revenue basket shows no underperformance vs low-foreign-revenue basket (t < 1.0) or positive.
theories.mechanism: A sharp DXY move up compresses translated earnings for US multinationals with high foreign revenue share, often flagged in 10-K geographic segment data.
theories.precursor: DXY daily change >= 2 trailing sd at close t.

theories.title: Macro lead-lag effect on commodity prices
theories.state_rule: status NEEDS_CELL, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: Commodity stocks do not move in the expected direction beyond their market beta within 5 trading days.
theories.mechanism: Commodity prices can lead or lag macroeconomic indicators like interest rates.
theories.precursor: A macroeconomic indicator like interest rates shows a significant change.

theories.title: Nat gas spike lifts gas producers over utilities
theories.state_rule: status NEEDS_CELL, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: No significant spread between gas producers and utilities after beta adjustment in the expected direction.
theories.mechanism: A sharp natural gas price increase benefits gas-weighted producers while squeezing utilities that must buy fuel, creating a relative move.
theories.precursor: Daily natural gas futures (NG=F) move >= 2 standard deviations at close t.

theories.title: Natural gas spike lifts fertilizer over chemical peers
theories.state_rule: status NEEDS_CELL, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: Fertilizer-minus-chemicals spread is zero or positive in the t+1 to t+5 window after the gas shock.
theories.mechanism: A natural gas spike raises input costs for nitrogen fertilizer producers more than for specialty chemical producers, compressing fertilizer margins relative to chemicals.
theories.precursor: Henry Hub futures daily change >= 2 trailing sd at close t; gas intensity disclosed in filings.

theories.title: Oil price shock lifts energy sector but drags transports
theories.state_rule: status NEEDS_CELL, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If the energy-transport return spread does not widen significantly beyond its historical beta-adjusted expectation over the next 5 days, the hypothesis is refuted.
theories.mechanism: A sharp oil price increase boosts energy sector earnings expectations but raises fuel costs for transportation firms, leading to divergent returns that may not be fully reflected in sector ETFs due to slow rebalancing.
theories.precursor: Daily change in CL=F exceeds 2 standard deviations of its trailing 60-day volatility.

theories.title: Oil spike transmits to airline basket with one-day lag
theories.state_rule: status NEEDS_CELL, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If high-fuel-exposure airlines' beta-adjusted residual at t+1 is not more negative than low-exposure peers (spread >= 0, t < 1.5), refuted.
theories.mechanism: A crude oil shock raises jet-fuel cost expectations; airlines with limited hedging and high fuel-cost share see margin downgrades, so their next-session residual return is negative beyond market beta.
theories.precursor: CL=F daily change z-score >= 2 at close t; airlines classified by disclosed hedge ratio and fuel-cost share from prior filings.

theories.title: 10Y yield shock hits unprofitable small caps next open
theories.state_rule: status NEEDS_CELL, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: Unprofitable small-cap basket IWM-hedged t+1 return shows no negative tilt after TNX shocks.
theories.mechanism: A sharp 10Y jump raises the discount rate most for long-duration cash flows, so unprofitable small caps underperform from t+1 open to close before the effect broadens.
theories.precursor: TNX daily change >= 2 sd at close t.

theories.title: Credit spread widening hits small-cap cyclicals over large-cap
theories.state_rule: status NEEDS_CELL, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: Spread strategy shows no negative excess return for small-cap leg vs large-cap leg (t < 1.0) or positive.
theories.mechanism: HY spread spikes raise refinancing risk disproportionately for small-cap cyclicals with floating-rate debt; large-cap cyclicals have locked-in low coupons.
theories.precursor: HYG or HY OAS daily change >= 2 trailing sd at close t.

theories.title: Macro lead-lag effect on interest rates
theories.state_rule: status NEEDS_CELL, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: Financial stocks do not show a return increase beyond their market beta within 5 trading days.
theories.mechanism: Interest rate changes can lead or lag macroeconomic indicators like GDP growth.
theories.precursor: A macroeconomic indicator like GDP growth shows a significant change.

theories.title: Post-2023 regime: yield spike -> regional banks fall next session (forward log)
theories.state_rule: status NEEDS_CELL, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: forward shocks from the registration date: mean signed next-session residual <= 0 after 20 shocks
theories.mechanism: After the 2023 deposit-run episode, regional banks trade as rate-risk victims rather than NIM winners; a yield spike is followed by a further next-session fall.
theories.precursor: ^TNX change at close t beyond 2 trailing sd

theories.title: Rate shock hits high-duration small caps asymmetrically
theories.state_rule: status NEEDS_CELL, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: If high-duration small caps' beta-adjusted residual at t+1 is not more negative than matched low-duration peers (spread >= 0, t < 1.5), refuted.
theories.mechanism: A sharp rise in 10Y yield raises discount rates; long-duration small caps with negative near-term cash flows de-rate more than short-duration peers, so their next-session residual return is more negative.
theories.precursor: 10Y yield daily change z-score >= 2 at close t; small caps pre-classified by cash-flow duration proxy (R&D/sales, years-to-profitability).

theories.title: House PTR purchases entered after disclosure (TRIAL-CONGRESS-PTR-FWD-1)
theories.state_rule: status NEEDS_CELL, no verdict yet (untested)
theories.refutation: decision read 2028-04-01: t <= 0, or NOT_DETECTABLE if the MDE stays above 0.5pp
theories.mechanism: Members' purchases carry information not priced by the disclosure date

theories.title: Size effect on analyst downgrades

theories.refutation: The stock's return is above its market beta and volatility does not increase in the next trading session.

theories.title: Tone agreement increment for next-session size

theories.title: Volatility compression post-earnings

theories.refutation: The stock's return is below the market beta, with an increase in implied volatility after the next trading day.

theories.title: Part of quality_composite / cash_lowvol's twin t is restated (current-vintage) data

theories.refutation: If the insurer basket does not outperform vol-matched sector controls from open t+1 to close t+5, or if the effect appears equally in non-rate-sensitive financials, the hypothesis is refuted.
theories.mechanism: A sharp rise in the 10-year Treasury yield improves reinvestment income for life insurers with long-duration liabilities, lifting their shares relative to market beta.
theories.precursor: A daily change in ^TNX at close t with |change| >= 2.0 trailing sd.

theories.title: AI leader shock -> semi equipment lag
theories.state_rule: verdict FAILED_VARIANT and POWERED: this variant fails; the family stays open
theories.refutation: confirm-fold mean signed residual <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE below the design effect
theories.mechanism: A large move in the AI-chip leaders changes expected foundry and tool orders; suppliers (equipment, foundry) catch up over the next sessions.
theories.precursor: equal-weight NVDA/AVGO/AMD close-to-close move at close t beyond 2 trailing sd

theories.title: DeepSeek reads earnings-surprise size from the text
theories.state_rule: verdict FAILED_VARIANT and POWERED: this variant fails; the family stays open
theories.refutation: the two folds disagree in sign or both sit inside the MDE
theories.mechanism: Earnings text carries the surprise size, and the model can read it.
theories.precursor: masked earnings_report documents, same-date ranking, two folds

theories.title: Supplier earnings miss hits customer next session
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: If linked customers show no significant next-session abnormal return relative to vol-matched unlinked peers, the hypothesis is refuted.
theories.mechanism: A key supplier's earnings miss signals cost pressure or demand weakness that will show up in the customer's margins, so the customer's stock drifts down the next session as investors connect the dots.
theories.precursor: Supplier (co-mentioned in prior news as a supplier) reports earnings miss with >2 sd reaction at close t.

theories.title: Supplier readthrough after customer guidance cut
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: No significant supplier underperformance versus vol-matched unlinked peers in the confirm window.
theories.mechanism: When a large customer cuts guidance, its disclosed suppliers face demand uncertainty and sell off the next session as investors reprice their order books.
theories.precursor: Customer's guidance_change event with a large negative reaction and a previously co-mentioned supplier list from news.

theories.title: Equity issuance dilution hits co-mentioned peers
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: No excess negative abnormal return for co-mentioned peers versus vol-matched unlinked peers.
theories.mechanism: A dilutive equity issuance by one firm signals sector-wide capital needs, pressuring co-mentioned peers with similar funding profiles.
theories.precursor: Equity_issuance_dilution event on a source name with high co-mention ratio to peers.

theories.title: Utility wildfire liability news hits peer utilities with similar exposure
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: If fire-prone peers do not underperform low-risk utilities in the 1-5 day window, refuted.
theories.mechanism: A wildfire liability event (e.g., PG&E-like) raises perceived regulatory and legal risk for other utilities operating in fire-prone regions. Investors reprice peers with similar geographic exposure.
theories.precursor: Public news of a wildfire-related liability event or regulatory penalty for a utility, before next open.

theories.title: Customer guidance cut hits supplier basket
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: No difference in next-session abnormal returns between linked suppliers and unlinked sector peers.
theories.mechanism: A large customer's negative guidance signals weaker orders, so its suppliers should sell off the following session.
theories.precursor: Major customer's guidance_change event with negative surprise and public supplier links/co-mentions.

theories.title: Drug approval lifts contract manufacturing peers
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: Modality-exposed CDMOs show no incremental return vs non-exposed CDMOs in the session after approval.
theories.mechanism: When a biotech wins FDA approval for a novel modality, contract development and manufacturing organizations with disclosed relationships to that modality see order-flow read-through.
theories.precursor: FDA approval is public at t; CDMO modality exposure is disclosed in filings or earnings calls.

theories.title: New contract win lifts co-mentioned suppliers
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: No difference in next-session abnormal returns between linked suppliers and vol-matched unlinked peers.
theories.mechanism: A large new contract or partnership signals demand pull, benefiting co-mentioned suppliers who provide inputs to the winner.
theories.precursor: New_contract_or_partnership event on a source name with high co-mention ratio to supplier names.

theories.title: Supplier guidance cut drags customer margins
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: Linked customers show no larger next-session abnormal return than vol-matched unlinked names.
theories.mechanism: When a key supplier cuts guidance citing input-cost or demand weakness, its downstream customers face the same cost/demand shock and get repriced next session.
theories.precursor: Supplier's guidance_change event with negative surprise and a public customer/supplier relationship or co-mention link.

theories.title: Supplier guidance cut hits customer margin expectation
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: Linked customers show no incremental next-session return vs unlinked sector peers after controlling for market and sector beta.
theories.mechanism: When a key supplier cuts guidance due to input-cost deflation, downstream customers with contracted pass-through pricing see margin expansion as input costs fall faster than their own selling prices.
theories.precursor: Supplier reports guidance cut citing falling input costs (public at t), customer is a known large purchaser of that input.

theories.title: Supplier guidance cut hits customer margin expectations
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: Linked customers show no next-session excess return vs vol-matched unlinked peers (t < 1.0) or sign flips.
theories.mechanism: A key supplier's guidance cut signals input cost relief or demand weakness for its customers; customers with high supplier concentration re-rate on margin expectations before their own earnings.
theories.precursor: Supplier (source) issues guidance_change with |reaction| > 2x its own 60d vol; customer list known from prior co-mentions.

theories.title: Trucking bankruptcy lifts remaining carriers pricing power
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_OF_CLOSED: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: No return differential between spot-exposed and contract-only carriers in the 5 sessions after the bankruptcy filing.
theories.mechanism: When a large truckload carrier files bankruptcy, capacity exits the market, tightening spot rates and lifting pricing power for surviving carriers with spot-exposed contracts.
theories.precursor: Public bankruptcy filing by a top-10 truckload carrier; survivors with high spot-rate exposure are identifiable.

theories.title: Analyst target cut read-through to supply-chain peers
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: If the supply-chain peer basket does not underperform vol-matched sector controls the next session, or if the effect appears equally in non-linked names, the hypothesis is refuted.
theories.mechanism: A large analyst target cut on a bellwether name signals demand weakness that propagates to its supply-chain peers, causing correlated next-session underperformance beyond sector beta.
theories.precursor: An analyst_target_change event with a large negative source reaction and pre-existing co-mentions with supply-chain peers.

theories.title: Analyst target hike on leader lifts laggard peers next session
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: Linked laggards show no positive next-session excess return vs unlinked (t < 1.0) or negative sign.
theories.mechanism: A prominent analyst_target_change upward on a sector leader often precedes similar revisions on laggard peers as the analyst coverage cascade unfolds.
theories.precursor: Leader receives analyst_target_change with positive surprise > 2x vol; laggard peers identified by co-mention in analyst notes.

theories.title: Guidance cut at a supplier drags its disclosed customers
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: Co-mentioned customers' next-session abnormal return is statistically indistinguishable from vol-matched unlinked peers.
theories.mechanism: A supplier guiding down signals weakening end-demand for its named customers, and co-mentioned customer names get re-rated the next session before sell-side notes land.
theories.precursor: Supplier earnings/guidance event with |reaction| >= 3 sd and at least 3 co-mentioned customer tickers in prior 90-day news.

theories.title: Insurer cat-bond read-through after reinsurance loss shock
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: No cross-sectional spread between light-cat and heavy-cat P&C insurers beyond sector beta in the 5 days after the event.
theories.mechanism: A large reinsurance loss event forces primary insurers to reprice catastrophe risk, benefiting peers with lighter cat exposure as pricing hardens.
theories.precursor: Public news of a major insured catastrophe loss exceeding USD 1bn, known before the next open.

theories.title: Regulatory approval for one device lifts co-mentioned device peers
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: Linked peers show no positive next-session excess return vs unlinked (t < 1.0) or negative sign.
theories.mechanism: FDA approval for a novel device signals regulatory pathway clarity for peers with similar PMA/510(k) filings, lifting their expected approval probability.
theories.precursor: Source medtech reports regulatory_approval with positive reaction > 2x vol; peers co-mentioned in prior FDA news.

theories.title: Semiconductor equipment export controls lift domestic toolmakers
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: If low-China US toolmakers do not outperform high-China peers after the announcement, refuted.
theories.mechanism: New export controls on semiconductor equipment to China raise barriers for foreign competitors, benefiting domestic US toolmakers with less China exposure. Equity re-rates on expected share gains.
theories.precursor: Public announcement of new US export controls on semiconductor equipment, before next open.

theories.title: Supplier co-mention read-through after customer guidance cut
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: If linked suppliers' next-session abnormal return is not more negative than vol-matched unlinked suppliers, the read-through is absent.
theories.mechanism: When a large customer cuts guidance, its named suppliers face demand uncertainty and analysts revise down; co-mentioned suppliers reprice next session.
theories.precursor: Customer's negative guidance_change event with big same-day drop, and supplier co-mentioned in prior news within 90 days.

theories.title: Supplier read-through after customer guidance cut
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: Linked suppliers show no excess next-session move vs unlinked vol-matched peers.
theories.mechanism: When a large customer cuts guidance, its named suppliers fall more than their own volatility the next session due to revenue concentration.
theories.precursor: Customer's guidance cut with negative reaction, plus supplier named in customer's 10-K as >10% revenue source.

theories.title: Insider cluster buys predict peer read-through
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: If correlated peers show no abnormal return versus vol-matched non-peers after cluster buys, spillover is refuted.
theories.mechanism: Multiple insiders buying at one firm signals sector undervaluation, spilling over to closely correlated peers next session.
theories.precursor: Three or more insider buys at a source firm within 10 days, and a peer with top decile return correlation.

theories.title: Abnormal attention increases move size beyond volatility
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: If abnormal attention does not add rank IC for next-session move size over trailing volatility and TF-IDF, the hypothesis is refuted.
theories.mechanism: Stocks with abnormally high news attention attract more traders, leading to larger price moves the next session even after controlling for trailing volatility and text content.
theories.precursor: Abnormal news attention (article count z-score) > 2 at close t.

theories.title: Abnormal attention increment for next-session size
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: No positive rank IC increment in the confirm fold for the attention feature.
theories.mechanism: Unusually high news attention for a stock predicts a larger absolute next-session move beyond trailing volatility and text tone.
theories.precursor: Cell-level abnormal attention feature computed from prior-day news volume versus trailing baseline.

theories.title: Abnormal attention increment for next-session size
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: If the feature does not add significant rank IC (t < 1) in the confirm fold, the increment is refuted.
theories.mechanism: A cell-level abnormal news attention feature adds incremental rank IC for the magnitude of next-session returns over trailing volatility and a TF-IDF text model, capturing attention-driven overreaction.
theories.precursor: Abnormal attention score computed from news volume relative to trailing baseline, known before next session.

theories.title: Abnormal attention increment on size of next-day move
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: Adding abn_attention to the size model yields rank IC increment <= 0 in the confirm fold.
theories.mechanism: Names with abnormal news attention (vs trailing 60-day baseline) attract more order flow at the open, enlarging the realized size of the next-session move beyond volatility and TF-IDF tone.
theories.precursor: Overnight news count for the ticker exceeds its 60-day mean by >= 2 sd.

theories.title: Attention spike amplifies next-session size after earnings
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: If abnormal attention adds no rank IC for next-session absolute return over vol and text model, the amplification is refuted.
theories.mechanism: Abnormal news attention around earnings raises disagreement and trading volume, increasing the magnitude of the next-session move.
theories.precursor: Earnings_report event with abnormal attention feature in top quintile, known before next open.

theories.title: Attention spike predicts larger next-day move size
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: Abnormal attention adds no rank IC increment for |next-day return| over trailing vol plus TF-IDF in the design fold.
theories.mechanism: Abnormal news attention on a name predicts a larger absolute next-session move conditional on trailing volatility, a size effect not captured by pure text sentiment.
theories.precursor: Abnormal article count z-score >=2 vs 60-day baseline, known before the open.

theories.title: Size attention to earnings
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: The stock's return is within 1 standard deviation of market beta after the next trading day.
theories.mechanism: Highly-attended earnings reports can boost company stocks for days.
theories.precursor: A company's attention score spikes before earnings announcement.

theories.title: Supply chain disruptions affecting small caps
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_OF_CLOSED: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: Small-cap stocks do not move more than their market beta in the expected direction within 3 trading days.
theories.mechanism: Supply chain disruptions can disproportionately affect smaller companies.
theories.precursor: A major supplier experiences a significant supply chain disruption.

theories.title: Tone agreement in news predicts larger next-session move
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: If high tone agreement does not predict a significantly larger absolute next-session return after controlling for trailing volatility and market beta, the hypothesis is refuted.
theories.mechanism: When multiple news articles about a stock agree in tone (all positive or all negative), it signals consensus information that reduces uncertainty, leading to a larger price impact as investors act on the news.
theories.precursor: For a given stock, the proportion of positive-sentiment articles among all articles on day t exceeds 80% or is below 20%, based on a pre-trained sentiment model.

theories.title: Tone agreement increment for next-session size
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: If the feature does not add significant rank IC (t < 1) in the confirm fold, the increment is refuted.
theories.mechanism: Agreement in tone across multiple news sources for a stock signals consensus information, reducing next-session return magnitude; disagreement increases it, adding rank IC beyond volatility and TF-IDF.
theories.precursor: Tone agreement score computed from news sentiment dispersion across sources, known before next session.

theories.title: Tone disagreement adds to size rank IC
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: If the incremental rank IC of tone_agreement over vol + TF-IDF is <= 0 in the confirm fold (t < 1), refuted.
theories.mechanism: When news tone across sources disagrees on a name, uncertainty about fundamentals is higher, so the next-session move size is larger than trailing volatility and TF-IDF alone predict.
theories.precursor: Cell-level tone_agreement feature computed from multi-source news before the open; high disagreement score.

theories.title: Tone disagreement widens move size after guidance changes
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: If tone disagreement does not improve rank IC for next-session absolute return beyond vol and text, it is refuted.
theories.mechanism: Conflicting analyst tone after guidance changes signals disagreement, producing larger next-session price moves.
theories.precursor: Guidance_change event with tone_agreement feature in bottom quintile, observable pre-open.

theories.title: Event prior increment for next-session size
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: If the feature does not add significant rank IC (t < 1) in the confirm fold, the increment is refuted.
theories.mechanism: The historical average absolute next-session return following a specific event type (e.g., earnings) provides a prior for the size of the next move, adding rank IC beyond volatility and TF-IDF.
theories.precursor: Event type identified from news before next session; historical event-type size prior computed from past data.

theories.title: Event-prior feature predicts next-session move size
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: Event-prior feature adds no rank IC increment for |next-day return| over trailing vol plus TF-IDF in the design fold.
theories.mechanism: A name's historical sensitivity to a given event type (earnings, guidance) predicts a larger next-session move size when that event recurs, beyond trailing vol.
theories.precursor: Event-type tag on today's news plus the name's 2-year event-sensitivity score, both known before the open.

theories.title: Event-prior rarity increases next-session move size
theories.state_rule: status DUPLICATE_IN_LEDGER: the question is already asked elsewhere
theories.refutation: If event_prior adds no rank IC for next-session absolute return over vol and text, rarity amplification is refuted.
theories.mechanism: Rare event types (e.g., first-time guidance withdrawal) carry more information and cause larger next-session moves than common events.
theories.precursor: Event_prior feature (historical frequency) in bottom decile for that event type, known before next open.

theory_cells.title: Federal fiscal-year-end spending: federal contractors in August-September
theory_cells.honesty: No corpse found for fiscal-year-end spend in hyp_lab or the strategy library; the nearest siblings (macro_lead_lag oil/yield cells) ended CANNOT_DISTINGUISH, so the prior is modest. Only 8 fiscal years per split: the gate's name-month MDE is an i.i.d. LOWER bound and the honest unit is the fiscal year -- with 8 validate FYs the comparison is likely unpowered; that is printed, not hidden. The agency-month precursor has NO point-in-time history before the first snapshot (2026-10-07): any backtest that uses today's revised monthly totals as if known in August is look-ahead and is barred. The gate links by TICKER over each CRSP name range, so a ticker reused by an unrelated firm inside 2008-2024 is counted (the gate's n is an upper bound); the runner must link by the crosswalk company's gvkey/permco.
theory_cells.refutation: validate (FY2017-FY2024) Aug-Sep minus own-baseline excess return <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE below the effect worth having; AND (dose) the high-federal-share tercile must not be below the low tercile -- an effect that does not scale with federal exposure is not this mechanism
theory_cells.primary: per FY: equal-weight basket (Aug-Sep compounded excess vs VW market) minus the same basket's mean monthly excess over the prior Oct-Jul x 2 months; net of one round trip (max(Corwin-Schultz, flat band))
